player_cards.name: One-Up
player_cards.text_en: Your opponent's bet increases by 1 while this card is on the table. Also, draw 1 trump card.
player_cards.text_pt: A aposta do oponente aumenta em 1 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa. Além disso, compre 1 carta trunfo.

player_cards.name: Two-Up
player_cards.text_en: Your opponent's bet increases by 2 while this card is on the table. Also, draw 1 trump card.
player_cards.text_pt: A aposta do oponente aumenta em 2 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa. Além disso, compre 1 carta trunfo.

player_cards.name: Two-Up+
player_cards.text_en: Return your opponent's last face-up card to the deck. Also, your opponent's bet increases by 2 while this card is on the table.
player_cards.text_pt: Devolve ao baralho a última carta virada para cima do oponente. Além disso, a aposta do oponente aumenta em 2 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa.

player_cards.name: 2 Card
player_cards.text_en: Draw the 2 card. If it is no longer in the deck, nothing happens.
player_cards.text_pt: Compra a carta 2. Se ela não estiver mais no baralho, nada acontece.

player_cards.name: 3 Card
player_cards.text_en: Draw the 3 card. If it is no longer in the deck, nothing happens.
player_cards.text_pt: Compra a carta 3. Se ela não estiver mais no baralho, nada acontece.

player_cards.name: 4 Card
player_cards.text_en: Draw the 4 card. If it is no longer in the deck, nothing happens.
player_cards.text_pt: Compra a carta 4. Se ela não estiver mais no baralho, nada acontece.

player_cards.name: 5 Card
player_cards.text_en: Draw the 5 card. If it is no longer in the deck, nothing happens.
player_cards.text_pt: Compra a carta 5. Se ela não estiver mais no baralho, nada acontece.

player_cards.name: 6 Card
player_cards.text_en: Draw the 6 card. If it is no longer in the deck, nothing happens.
player_cards.text_pt: Compra a carta 6. Se ela não estiver mais no baralho, nada acontece.

player_cards.name: 7 Card
player_cards.text_en: Draw the 7 card. If it is no longer in the deck, nothing happens.
player_cards.text_pt: Compra a carta 7. Se ela não estiver mais no baralho, nada acontece.

player_cards.name: Remove
player_cards.text_en: Return the last face-up card your opponent drew to the deck
player_cards.text_pt: Devolve ao baralho a última carta virada para cima que o oponente comprou.

player_cards.name: Return
player_cards.text_en: Return the last face-up card you drew to the deck.
player_cards.text_pt: Devolve ao baralho a última carta virada para cima que você comprou.

player_cards.name: Exchange
player_cards.text_en: Swap the last cards drawn by you and your opponent. (Face-down cards cannot be swapped.)
player_cards.text_pt: Troca as últimas cartas compradas por você e pelo oponente. (Cartas viradas para baixo não podem ser trocadas.)
player_cards.unlock: Use a total of 10 trump cards.

player_cards.name: Trump Switch
player_cards.text_en: Discard two of your trump cards at random, then draw three more trump cards. This card can be used even if you posses less than 2 other trump cards.
player_cards.text_pt: Descarta 2 das suas cartas trunfo aleatoriamente e depois compra mais 3. Pode ser usada mesmo se você tiver menos de 2 outras cartas trunfo.

player_cards.name: Trump Switch+
player_cards.text_en: Discard one of your trump cards at random, then draw four more trump cards. This card can be used even if you posses less than 1 other trump cards
player_cards.text_pt: Descarta 1 das suas cartas trunfo aleatoriamente e depois compra mais 4. Pode ser usada mesmo se você não tiver outras cartas trunfo.
player_cards.unlock: Win a round having used at least 15 trump cards.

player_cards.name: Shield
player_cards.text_en: Your bet is reduced by 1 while this card is on the table.
player_cards.text_pt: Sua aposta é reduzida em 1 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa.

player_cards.name: Shield+
player_cards.text_en: Your bet is reduced by 2 while this card is on the table.
player_cards.text_pt: Sua aposta é reduzida em 2 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa.
player_cards.unlock: Defeat 2 opponents in a row without being tortured once.

player_cards.name: Destroy
player_cards.text_en: Remove the last trump card your opponent places on the table.
player_cards.text_pt: Remove a última carta trunfo que o oponente colocou na mesa.

player_cards.name: Destroy+
player_cards.text_en: Remove all your opponent's trump cards from the table.
player_cards.text_pt: Remove todas as cartas trunfo do oponente da mesa.
player_cards.unlock: Remove a total of 10 trump cards from the opponents' side.

player_cards.name: Destroy++
player_cards.text_en: Remove all of your opponent's trump cards from the table. Your opponent cannot use trump cards while this is on the table.
player_cards.text_pt: Remove todas as cartas trunfo do oponente da mesa. O oponente não pode usar cartas trunfo enquanto esta estiver na mesa.
player_cards.unlock: Remove a total of 20 trump cards from the opponents' side.

player_cards.name: Perfect Draw
player_cards.text_en: Draw the best possible card from the deck.
player_cards.text_pt: Compra a melhor carta possível do baralho.

player_cards.name: Perfect Draw+
player_cards.text_en: Draw the best possible card from the deck. Also, your opponent's bet increases by 5 while this card is on the table.
player_cards.text_pt: Compra a melhor carta possível do baralho. Além disso, a aposta do oponente aumenta em 5 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa.

player_cards.name: Ultimate Draw
player_cards.text_en: Draw the best possible card from the deck. Also, draw two trump cards.
player_cards.text_pt: Compra a melhor carta possível do baralho. Além disso, compra 2 cartas trunfo.

player_cards.name: Go for 17
player_cards.text_en: The closest to 17 wins while this card is on the table. Replaces other "Go For" cards that are already on the table.
player_cards.text_pt: Enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa, vence quem chegar mais perto de 17. Substitui outras cartas "Go For" que já estejam na mesa.

player_cards.name: Go for 24
player_cards.text_en: The closest to 24 wins while this card is on the table. Replaces other "Go For" cards that are already on the table.
player_cards.text_pt: Enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa, vence quem chegar mais perto de 24. Substitui outras cartas "Go For" que já estejam na mesa.

player_cards.name: Go for 27
player_cards.text_en: The closest to 27 wins while this card is on the table. Replaces other "Go For" cards that are already on the table.
player_cards.text_pt: Enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa, vence quem chegar mais perto de 27. Substitui outras cartas "Go For" que já estejam na mesa.
player_cards.unlock: Reach 21 at least of 3 times in a row.

player_cards.name: Harvest
player_cards.text_en: You draw a trump card after every trump card use while this card is on the table.
player_cards.text_pt: Enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa, você compra uma carta trunfo depois de cada uso de carta trunfo.
player_cards.unlock: Defeat the elusive Mr. Big Head 2 times.

player_cards.name: Love Your Enemy
player_cards.text_en: Your opponent draws the best possible card for them from the deck.
player_cards.text_pt: O oponente compra do baralho a melhor carta possível para ele.

enemy_cards.name: Shield Assault
enemy_cards.text_en: Remove three Shield-type cards from your side of the table. Your opponent's bet is raised by 3 while this card is on the table.
enemy_cards.text_pt: Remove 3 cartas do tipo Shield do seu lado da mesa. A aposta do oponente aumenta em 3 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa.

enemy_cards.name: Shield Assault+
enemy_cards.text_en: Remove two Shield-type cards from your side of the table. Your opponent's bet is raised by 5 while this card is on the table.
enemy_cards.text_pt: Remove 2 cartas do tipo Shield do seu lado da mesa. A aposta do oponente aumenta em 5 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa.

enemy_cards.name: Happiness
enemy_cards.text_en: Both players draw one trump card.
enemy_cards.text_pt: Os dois jogadores compram 1 carta trunfo.

enemy_cards.name: Desire
enemy_cards.text_en: Your opponent's bet is raised by half the number of trump cards they are holding while this card is on the table.
enemy_cards.text_pt: Enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa, a aposta do oponente aumenta em metade do número de cartas trunfo que ele tem na mão.

enemy_cards.name: Desire+
enemy_cards.text_en: Your opponent's bet is raised by the number of trump cards they are holding while this card is on the table.
enemy_cards.text_pt: Enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa, a aposta do oponente aumenta no número de cartas trunfo que ele tem na mão.

enemy_cards.name: Mind Shift
enemy_cards.text_en: Your opponent loses half of their trump cards at the end of the round. This card is removed if they use two trump cards in one turn.
enemy_cards.text_pt: O oponente perde metade das cartas trunfo no fim da rodada. Esta carta é removida se ele usar 2 cartas trunfo em um mesmo turno.

effects.removed_if: opponent uses 2 trumps in one turn

enemy_cards.name: Mind Shift+
enemy_cards.text_en: Your opponent loses all of their trump cards at the end of the round. This card is removed if they use three trump cards in one turn.
enemy_cards.text_pt: O oponente perde todas as cartas trunfo no fim da rodada. Esta carta é removida se ele usar 3 cartas trunfo em um mesmo turno.

effects.removed_if: opponent uses 3 trumps in one turn

enemy_cards.name: Conjure
enemy_cards.text_en: Draw three trump cards. However, your bet is raised by 1 while this card is on the table.
enemy_cards.text_pt: Compra 3 cartas trunfo. Porém, sua aposta aumenta em 1 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa.

enemy_cards.name: Curse
enemy_cards.text_en: Discard one of your trump cards at random, and force your opponent to draw the highest number card from the deck.
enemy_cards.text_pt: Descarta 1 das suas cartas trunfo aleatoriamente e obriga o oponente a comprar a carta de maior número do baralho.

enemy_cards.name: Black Magic
enemy_cards.text_en: Dicard half your trump cards and draw the best possible number card. Opponent's bet is raise by 10 when this is on table.
enemy_cards.text_pt: Descarta metade das suas cartas trunfo e compra a melhor carta numérica possível. A aposta do oponente aumenta em 10 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa.

enemy_cards.name: Escape
enemy_cards.text_en: Provided this card is still on the table, you run for your life at the end of the round.
enemy_cards.text_pt: Se esta carta ainda estiver na mesa, você foge para salvar a vida no fim da rodada.

enemy_cards.name: Twenty-One-Up
enemy_cards.text_en: Provided your card total is 21, the opponent's bet is raised by 21 while this card is on the table.
enemy_cards.text_pt: Se a soma das suas cartas for 21, a aposta do oponente aumenta em 21 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa.

enemy_cards.name: Oblivion
enemy_cards.text_en: Cancels this round, and begins a new round instead.
enemy_cards.text_pt: Cancela esta rodada e começa uma nova rodada no lugar.

enemy_cards.name: Dead Silence
enemy_cards.text_en: Your opponent cannot draw cards, even via trump card effects, while this is card on the table.
enemy_cards.text_pt: O oponente não pode comprar cartas, nem mesmo por efeito de cartas trunfo, enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa.

enemy_cards.name: Desperation
enemy_cards.text_en: Both players' bets are raised by 100 while this card is on the table. Opponent cannot draw cards, even via trump card effects.
enemy_cards.text_pt: As apostas dos dois jogadores aumentam em 100 enquanto esta carta estiver na mesa. O oponente não pode comprar cartas, nem mesmo por efeito de cartas trunfo.
enemy_cards.used_by: (não especificado; usada por Lucas no modo História)
